text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good leaders use several key skills to succeed. Clear communication is the foundation, because team members need to understand their goals and tasks. Effective delegation is also vital, as it allows leaders to share responsibilities and help people grow. Giving regular feedback helps everyone improve and feel valued, which supports motivation and keeps the team engaged. Even in strong teams, disagreements happen, so leaders must handle conflict resolution calmly and fairly. When these skills are combined, a team can work together productively and reach its objectives.
